question.title: Layering the Paint Coats
question.content:
A restorer must apply coats coats of paint, numbered from 0 to coats - 1. Each entry under[i] = [a, b] means coat a must go on at some point before coat b.

Return an order that applies every coat exactly once and respects every entry of under. If there are several valid orders, return any of them. The input guarantees that at least one exists.

 

Example 1:

Input: coats = 6, under = [[5,0],[5,2],[0,3],[2,3],[3,1],[4,1]]
Output: [4,5,0,2,3,1]

Example 2:

Input: coats = 5, under = [[1,0],[2,0],[3,1],[3,2],[4,3]]
Output: [4,3,1,2,0]
Explanation: Coats 1 and 2 could also swap places.

 

Constraints:

  • 1 <= coats <= 2000
  • 0 <= under.length <= 5000
  • under[i].length == 2
  • 0 <= a, b < coats
  • a != b
  • No entry appears twice.
